text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-senpai! Receiving birthday wishes 
from you makes me feel like today's going 
to be a wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! I really wanted to ask 
you something... If I recall correctly, 
Kris S-senpai, you're quite particular 
about your water, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's drinkable spring water 
on my favorite hiking trail... and I was 
hoping to hear your thoughts on it, Kris 
S-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is deep in the mountains, but... I can 
guide you there. Would you care to join 
me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like you're having fun, but... I 
was actually hoping to... celebrate your 
birthday today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I feel happy—no, this isn't right.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No, not at all. I'm the one who 
wants to hear your thoughts, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you like it, Senpai, I'll be delighted. 
And even if you don't, I'll still be happy 
to learn what you prefer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think? Wouldn't this be... a 
win-win?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness...! Fufu. I'm really 
looking forward to it now!
